parameters.responseBody:
={
  "success": true,
  "workflow": "Emergency Alert",
  "status": "PENDING APPROVAL",
  "emergencyAlert": "PENDING APPROVAL",
  "alertPayload": $json.alertPayload,
  "message": "Emergency Public Alert drafted. Commander signature required before broadcast.",
  "timestamp": new Date().toISOString()
}

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "service": "SIMULATED_CELL_BROADCAST_EAS",
  "alertId": $json.alertPayload.alertId,
  "headline": $json.alertPayload.headline,
  "instruction": $json.alertPayload.instruction,
  "simulationMode": true,
  "disclaimer": "Simulated Emergency Broadcast: Prototype mode. External public sirens/EAS are NOT triggered."
}

parameters.responseBody:
={
  "success": true,
  "workflow": "Emergency Alert",
  "status": "PUBLISHED",
  "emergencyAlert": "SIMULATED",
  "alert": $json.alertPayload,
  "auditLog": $json.auditLog,
  "disclaimer": "Simulation mode: alert published to mock public notification receiver stubs.",
  "timestamp": new Date().toISOString()
}
